RLS POLICY SPEC

Objective:
Secure database using Row Level Security.

Policies:

users

Resident can read only their own record

Admin can read all

payments

Resident can read only their own payments

Admin full access

complaints

Resident can insert and read their own

Admin full access

notices

All authenticated users can read

Admin can insert/update/delete

rooms

Readable by all authenticated users

Writable only by admin

Output Required:
SQL policies for all tables.
